import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Calculate effect sizes and p-values for all features
    effects = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, col]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, col]
        mean_diff = np.mean(y1) - np.mean(y0)
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
        auc = roc_auc_score(feats.y, feats.x[:, col])
        effects.append((fid, abs(mean_diff), abs(t_stat), p_val, auc))
    
    # Sort by effect size (t-statistic) and filter out weak features
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)
    strong_features = [f[0] for f in effects if f[2] > 2.0][:10]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    kept = set()
    for fid in strong_features:
        is_duplicate = False
        for kept_fid in kept:
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)], 
                              feats.x[:, feats.column(kept_fid)])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) > 0.6:
                is_duplicate = True
                break
        if not is_duplicate:
            kept.add(fid)
    
    # Select top drivers based on effect size
    drivers = list(kept)[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Build columns, products, and loadings
    columns = list(kept)
    products = []
    loadings = {fid: 1.0 for fid in kept}
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), 
                 products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)

def roc_auc_score(y_true, y_scores):
    # Simple AUC approximation using Mann-Whitney U test
    n1 = np.sum(y_true == 1)
    n2 = len(y_true) - n1
    ranks = stats.rankdata(y_scores)
    rank_sum_1 = np.sum(ranks[y_true == 1])
    auc = (rank_sum_1 - n1*(n1+1)/2) / (n1*n2)
    return max(0.5, auc)
